headline: Grab Holdings Boosts 2026 Forecasts on Strong Delivery and Ride-Hailing Demand
summary: Grab Holdings raised its full-year 2026 forecasts, driven by strong consumer demand across its delivery and ride-hailing segments.
why: As a leading Southeast Asian super-app, Grab's earnings and guidance provide a benchmark for regional consumer internet adoption and gig-economy profitability.

impacts.name: Grab Holdings
impacts.why: Upgraded forecasts reflect stronger revenue expectations from core operations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Upwardly revised guidance signals robust regional demand and improving operational margins in ride-hailing and delivery sectors.
